Description:
Calendar year in period t
Help:
The actual calendar year we are presently in at
time period t.
Note on New Business Layering:
When performing a run, new business always
incepts at time t=0, irrespective of the layer.
When consolidating the results from all the
layers on the drill-down, each layer is offset.
For example if our basic model point (layer 0)
incepts at the valuation date, say 31/12/1996,
then for this layer at time t=0 cal_year=1996, at
time t=1 cal_year=1997 etc.
The second layer (known as layer 1) should
incept at 31/1/1997. During the run of layer 1,
31/1/1997 is taken to be t=0, however when
presented in the drill-down it is offset to t=1. In
consequence during the run of layer 1 cal_year
at time t=0 is 1997.
